name: 合同（服务/价格/条款）生成

map.服务/价格/条款: Generate sample contract clauses and pricing text in batches by quantity, supporting first-draft contracts and clause-template tidying.
map.📖 查看「合同（服务/价格/条款）生成使用指南」: 📖 View the "Service Contract & Pricing Generator Guide"
map.小计 = 单价 × 数量；折扣额 = 小计 × 折扣率；含税价 = (小计 −: Subtotal = unit price × quantity; discount = subtotal × discount rate; taxed = (subtotal − discount) × (1 + tax rate); contract total = round(taxed); deposit = round(total × 30%); balance = total − deposit; penalty = round(total × 10%). The order is fixed: apply the discount first, then tax; discount and tax rates are entered as percentages.
map.起草服务合同时批量生成条款与报价样例，作为初稿再逐条修改。: When drafting a service contract, generate clauses and pricing samples in batches as a first draft, then edit them item by item.
map.时，用生成的样例补充常见条款措辞。: , use the generated samples to supplement common clause wording.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面按「单价 × 数量 → 折扣 → 税」算出合同总额、预付款: Set the count to 5; the page computes the contract total, deposit, balance and penalty by "unit price × quantity → discount → tax", then inserts those amounts into the service-clause drafts (service items rotate through the built-in list), ready to use as a quotation skeleton.
map.生成数量需为 1–50 的整数，超出范围会直接提示输入有误，不再按边界静默夹取；: The generation count must be an integer from 1 to 50; out-of-range values trigger an input error instead of being silently clamped. For more entries, generate in several batches and merge them.
map.生成的内容能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated content be used as a contract directly?
map.不能。生成的是措辞样例，条款效力、金额与权责需由双方确认并经法务审核，正式合同请: No. What is generated is sample wording; clause validity, amounts and responsibilities must be confirmed by both parties and reviewed by legal, and the approved version governs the formal contract.
map.按服务内容、价格与关键条款生成规范合同草稿: Generate a standard contract draft from the service scope, price and key clauses
map.家政与劳务协议快速起草: Drafting domestic-service and labour agreements quickly
map.服务范围与价格条款固化留存: Keeping the service scope and price clauses on file
map.给客户做报价前先生成几版不同服务项与价格的组合，供内部讨论取舍。: Before quoting a client, generate several combinations of service items and prices for internal discussion.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面从内置服务项（网站开发、品牌策划、法律咨询等）中随机组合，: Set the quantity to 5 and the page randomly combines built-in service items (website development, brand planning, legal consulting and so on) into quote entries with service content, quantity and amount in Chinese uppercase numerals, ready to serve as a quote skeleton.
map.生成数量被限制在 1–50 条之间，超出范围会按边界取值；需要更多条目可分次生成: The generation count is limited to 1-50 entries; out-of-range values are clamped to the boundary; for more entries, generate in batches and merge.
map.不会。生成与随机组合全部在浏览器本地完成，服务端不接收任何输入。: No. Generation and random combination happen entirely in your browser; the server receives no input.
map.当前为随机组合生成，暂不支持锁定指定项；可先生成再从结果中挑选合适的条目手工拼接: Generation is random for now and specific items cannot be locked; generate first, then pick suitable entries and combine them manually.
